# Operations

- OPS-003: Every HttpClient comes from IHttpClientFactory and gets the standard resilience handler (timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker) from the ServiceDefaults project, retrying only safe methods; a client that needs other settings removes the default handler (RemoveAllResilienceHandlers, experimental: suppress EXTEXP0001 with a reason) before adding its own. An app that needs cookies, which the factory's pooled handlers would share, keeps a long-lived HttpClient for each cookie container instead, over a SocketsHttpHandler with a PooledConnectionLifetime and wrapped in a ResilienceHandler, as the HttpClient guidelines page shows, decided by an ADR that also lifts the constructor ban there (CRF-010).
